	pww_ui_desk_float_gui = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "pww_ui_desk_float"
		visible = { has_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_float }
		dirty = pww_ui_dirty
		effects = {
			pww_ui_desk_close_click = {
				clr_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_open
				clr_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_float
				set_variable = { pww_ui_focus = -1 }
				clear_variable = pww_ui_end_arm
				add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
			}
			pww_ui_tab0_click = {
				set_variable = { pww_ui_tab = 0 }
				clear_variable = pww_ui_end_arm
				pww_ui_refresh = yes
			}
			pww_ui_tab1_click = {
				set_variable = { pww_ui_tab = 1 }
				clear_variable = pww_ui_end_arm
				pww_ui_refresh = yes
			}
			pww_ui_tab2_click = {
				set_variable = { pww_ui_tab = 2 }
				clear_variable = pww_ui_end_arm
				pww_ui_refresh = yes
			}
			pww_ui_desk_pg_next_click = {
				add_to_variable = { pww_ui_page = 1 }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_page < pww_ui_npages } } } set_variable = { pww_ui_page = 0 } }
				clear_variable = pww_ui_end_arm
				pww_ui_refresh = yes
			}
			pww_ui_desk_pg_prev_click = {
				subtract_from_variable = { pww_ui_page = 1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_page < 0 } } set_variable = { pww_ui_page = pww_ui_npages } subtract_from_variable = { pww_ui_page = 1 } }
				clear_variable = pww_ui_end_arm
				pww_ui_refresh = yes
			}
			pww_ui_dl0_end_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = pww_ui_end_arm check_variable = { pww_ui_end_arm = pww_ui_l0_id } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_l_ag = pww_ui_l0_id }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_l_by = THIS }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_l_cause = 0 }
					pww_ledger_withdraw = yes

	pww_ui_desk_button_gui = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "pww_ui_desk_button"
		parent_window_token = trade_tab
		visible = { always = yes }
		dirty = pww_ui_dirty
		effects = {
			pww_ui_desk_open_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_open has_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_float } }
					clr_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_open
					clr_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_float
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = pww_ui_desk_open
					set_variable = { pww_ui_news_ack = global.num_days }
					pww_ui_refresh = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}

	pww_ui_dossier_toggle_gui = {
		context_type = diplomacy_target_context
		window_name = "pww_ui_dossier_toggle"
		parent_window_token = selected_country_view_diplomacy
		visible = { NOT = { tag = ROOT } ROOT = { is_ai = no } }
		dirty = pww_ui_dirty
		effects = {
			pww_ui_dos_toggle_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = pww_ui_dos_open } }
				ROOT = {
					clr_country_flag = pww_ui_dos_open
					add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					pww_ui_country_summary = yes
					ROOT = {
						set_country_flag = pww_ui_dos_open
						pww_ui_refresh = yes
						add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
					}
					add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}
